the structural similarities of the short-chain helix cytokines, which are the IL1 family, the IL6 family, the IL8 family, and the IL10 family, have been clarified.
the cytokines IL-1alpha, IL-1beta and IL-18, which are structurally similar and are members of the IL-1 cytokine family, are produced in the same cells and share the same receptors.
the structural comparisons between the short-chain helices of the cytokines are not very different from the structural comparisons among the short chain helices of other protein families.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are two distinct classes of cytokines, one that is more similar in structure and the other that is more different in structure.
the structural differences between the short-chain helices and the longer cytokines are not as large as previously thought.
